title: Cleaner top banner
changes: The top banner shows just the week, and your team name gets room first so it fits in full on most phones.
The notification bell moved off the banner; turn alerts on or off from More > Notification preferences.

history.title: One Matchup page & easier navigation
changes: Matchup and Lineups are now one Matchup page: player cards for both lineups, the win probability graph, and the what-if calculator, with a compact week picker at the top.
The page buttons under each tab stay inside that tab and fit on one line.
Pull down from anywhere on the page, including matchup cards, to refresh.
Tables on phones no longer cut off numbers and names at the edge.
A slimmer top banner shows the current week on one line, and player sheets show the player's photo.

history.title: Team inboxes & mobile matchups
changes: Team inboxes keep your notifications in one place, with unread badges beside your team name.
Redesigned mobile matchups and rosters make player scores, projections, game details, and ownership easier to scan.
My Team now includes more scoring, lineup-efficiency, matchup, and FAAB metrics.
Player analysis includes position-specific weekly charts and add/drop trends.

history.title: Offline access & league rules
changes: The site opens from saved league data on weak signal and refreshes when connected.
League Rules brings ESPN roster, scoring, playoff, and waiver settings into the site.
